name: Wall
description: A creature type representing barriers such as walls, fences, gates and magical shields; this page is mostly about its game history.

timeline.summary: Walls are introduced in Alpha with ten walls across all colors.
timeline.quote: Walls were introduced in Alpha , which featured ten walls across all colors.

timeline.summary: With Champions of Kamigawa the Wall type no longer prevents attacking; the defender keyword takes over and older Walls get errata.
timeline.quote: Previously printed Walls recieved an errata giving them defender .
